confirmed_task:
On the National Weather Service forecast for Downtown Seattle, locate the first displayed daytime forecast period and the nighttime period immediately following it. Report each period’s name, conditions, temperature, precipitation chance, and wind forecast.

Stopping condition: Stop after one consecutive daytime-and-nighttime forecast pair and all requested fields have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not enable location access, alerts, or notifications.
- Use the first displayed daytime period rather than assuming that a Today period is present.
- Use the immediately following nighttime period.
- If precipitation chance is not stated for a period, report it as unavailable rather than guessing.

items.criterion: Access the National Weather Service forecast page for Downtown Seattle and reach the forecast period list
items.description: Navigate to the NWS forecast for Downtown Seattle (e.g., the provided MapClick link) and reach the section where forecast periods (day/night tiles or equivalent) are displayed. Full credit if the agent attempts access but the site is unavailable, blocked (e.g., CAPTCHA), or errors out, and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses a non-NWS source or an incorrect location page when the correct NWS page is accessible.

items.criterion: Identify the first displayed daytime forecast period (as shown)
items.description: Using the displayed sequence on the NWS page, select the first forecast period that is clearly a daytime period (do not assume a 'Today' label exists; use what is first displayed). Full credit if the correct first displayed daytime period is identified. Full credit if the page is accessible but the layout/content does not allow determining which period is the first daytime period and the agent clearly explains why. Partial credit if a later daytime period (or a non-daytime period) is chosen despite a clearly earlier daytime period being displayed.

items.criterion: Identify the immediately following nighttime period
items.description: From the same displayed sequence, identify the nighttime forecast period that immediately follows the chosen first displayed daytime period. Full credit if it is the next period after the daytime period. Full credit if the page is accessible but the next nighttime period cannot be determined due to missing/ambiguous ordering and the agent explains the limitation. Partial credit if a nighttime period is reported but it is not the immediately following one when ordering is clearly shown.

items.criterion: Report required fields for the daytime period
items.description: For the selected daytime period, report: period name, conditions, temperature, precipitation chance, and wind forecast exactly as shown on the NWS forecast. If precipitation chance is not stated for that period, it must be reported as 'unavailable'. Full credit if all five fields are provided or if the agent correctly indicates a field is unavailable because it is not stated/visible on the page. Partial credit if one field is missing or materially inaccurate when it is clearly available on the page.

items.criterion: Report required fields for the nighttime period
items.description: For the selected nighttime period, report: period name, conditions, temperature, precipitation chance, and wind forecast exactly as shown on the NWS forecast. If precipitation chance is not stated for that period, it must be reported as 'unavailable'. Full credit if all five fields are provided or if the agent correctly indicates a field is unavailable because it is not stated/visible on the page. Partial credit if one field is missing or materially inaccurate when it is clearly available on the page.

Stop after reporting exactly one consecutive daytime-and-nighttime forecast pair (no extra periods). Do not enable location access, alerts, or notifications. Full credit if only the required pair is reported and constraints are followed. Partial credit if extra periods are reported or if the agent implies enabling location/alerts/notifications. If the page is inaccessible and prevents reporting, do not penalize under this criterion as long as the agent does not violate constraints.
